04-bee-swarm-census.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette and composite swarm+boxplot layout show real design intent, but the top-earner callout text clips at the right viewport edge and percentile labels collide with the subtitle text — concrete layout bugs that prevent it from feeling finished.
04-bee-swarm-census.encoding_integrity_note: Honest dot-position encoding on a correctly chosen log scale for income, uniform dot radii (no lie factor), data-driven percentile/box-plot statistics, but xScale domain is slightly hardcoded ([14000,550000]) rather than derived from d3.extent, and no key functions in joins (acceptable with no dynamic updates).
04-bee-swarm-census.stress_test_note: Force simulation is pre-computed and stopped before render; only interactions are pointer-event tooltips (CSS-only position updates, no data joins or DOM mutations on move), no brush/zoom/transitions/cross-view dispatch — no meaningful interaction robustness violations.
04-bee-swarm-census.cognitive_load_note: 4-color Tol palette and pre-computed swarm keep 400 points readable; the two views share a log x-axis cleanly, but the 5 leader-line callouts converge in a tight right-tail cluster and create minor visual tangle.
